mapper.select: SELECT r.code FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY r.code

SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY p.code
SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE code = #{code} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
